about_the_game:
Electrician Simulator VR: Smart Devices – Original Soundtrack

Step into the future of electricity with the Smart Devices DLC soundtrack. This collection of modern, electronic-inspired ambient tracks captures the sleek, futuristic feel of smart homes and high-tech gadgets.

From subtle pulses to smooth digital tones, each piece is crafted to enhance your VR experience - whether you’re wiring motion sensors, configuring smart switches, or just relaxing with the glow of colorful lights. Perfect for staying focused, immersed, and in the flow of your electrical journey.
